chunks: As for after the death of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, then indeed:
611 - It was narrated from Juwayriyah ibn Mushir that he said:

We came with Amir al-Mu'minin, Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام, from the killing of the Khawarij, until when we had crossed into the land of Babil, the salat of al-'Asr became due. Then Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام dismounted, and the people dismounted. So Ali عليه السلام said: 'O people, this is a cursed land which has been punished in time three times.' And in another report: 'Twice, and it is expecting the third; and it is one of the overturned lands, and it is the first land in which an idol was worshipped, and it is not lawful for a prophet nor for the successor of a prophet to perform salat in it. So whoever among you wishes to perform salat, then let him perform salat.' Then the people moved to the sides of the road, praying, while he عليه السلام mounted the mule of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and went on.

Juwayriyah said: So I said, 'By Allah, I will surely follow Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, and I will surely entrust my salat today to his lead.' So I went behind him, and by Allah, we had not crossed the bridge of Sura' until the sun had set, and I began to doubt.

Then he turned to me and said: 'O Juwayriyah, did you doubt?' I said: 'Yes, O Amir al-Mu'minin.' So he عليه السلام dismounted to one side, performed wudu (ablution), then stood and uttered words that I could not make out, except that it was as though they were in Hebrew. Then he called the salat, and I looked, by Allah, at the sun, and it had come out from between two mountains, with a creaking sound. Then he performed the salat of al-'Asr, and I performed salat with him. So when we had finished our salat, the night returned as it had been.
Then he turned to me and said: 'O Juwayriyah ibn Mushir, indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says:
'So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.'
And I asked Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, by His Great Name, so He returned the sun to me.
And it was narrated: that when Juwayriyah saw that, he said: 'By the Lord of the Ka'bah, you are the successor of a prophet.'

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.الْخَوَارِجِ: the Khawarij, the group fought by Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.بَابِلَ: Babil, the land identified in the narration as cursed
key_terms.بِاسْمِهِ الْعَظِيمِ: by His Great Name, through which the supplication was made
key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ: the afternoon salat that became due during the journey
key_terms.فَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ الشَّمْسَ: He returned the sun to me, referring to the miracle described
key_terms.وَصِيِّ نَبِيٍّ: the successor or legatee of a prophet

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about Imam Ali عليه السلام and the return of the sun in the land of Babil?
ai.summary: This narration recounts a journey with Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام after the battle against the Khawarij, during which he refrained from performing salat in the land of Babil and explained its condemned status. It then describes the return of the sun by the permission of Allah so that he could perform salat al-'Asr, presenting this as a sign of his rank as the wasi of a prophet.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
As for after the death of the Prophet:
Hadith.611 - It was narrated from Juwayriyah ibn Mus-hir that He said:
"We were coming with The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), from the battle with the Khawarij. When we reached the land of Babil (Babylon), the time for Asr prayer approached.
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) dismounted, and the people dismounted as well.
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), said: 'O’ people, this is a cursed land that has been punished three times in the past' (in another version, 'twice, and it is expecting a third punishment'). 'It is one of the overturned lands, and it was the first land where an idol was worshipped. It is not permissible for a prophet or the successor of a prophet to pray in it. Whoever among you wishes to pray may do so.'
So, the people moved to the sides of the path to pray, while He (as) mounted the mule of the Messenger of Allah (sw) and continued on.
Juwayriyah said: 'I said to myself, "By Allah (swt), I will follow The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) and will imitate his prayer today."
So, I went after him. By Allah (swt), we did not cross the bridge of Surah until the sun had set, and I began to doubt.'
He (Ali) turned to me and said: 'Juwayriyah, do you doubt?'
I replied: 'Yes, O’ Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as))‘.
He dismounted, performed ablution, stood, and uttered words that I did not understand, as if they were in Hebrew.
Then he called for prayer, and I saw, by Allah (swt), the sun emerge from between two mountains, making a sound as it rose.
He then prayed the Asr prayer, and I prayed with him. When we finished our prayer, the night returned to how it was.
He turned to me and said: 'Juwayriyah ibn Mus-hir, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, says: 
"So exalt the name of your Lord (azj), the Most Great" (Qur'an 56:74). 
I asked Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, by His Greatest Name, and He returned the sun for me.'
It is narrated that when Juwayriyah witnessed this, He said:
'By the Lord (azj) of the Kaaba, you are the successor of a prophet.'"
